asia_europe_container.title: Asia-Europe ULCV Container Service
asia_europe_container.description: High-volume liner loop linking East Asia to Northern Europe across 11,500 nautical miles, optimizing vessel count, cruising speed, and alternative fuel transition under EU ETS carbon penalties.

australia_china_bulk.title: Australia-China Capesize Iron Ore Corridor
australia_china_bulk.description: Heavy industrial bulk commodity shuttle from Port Hedland to Shanghai. Evaluates slow steaming economics, LNG dual-fuel retrofit viability, and port shore power feasibility.

middle_east_europe_tanker.title: Arabian Gulf to Rotterdam VLCC Crude Route
middle_east_europe_tanker.description: Long-haul crude carrier shuttle between Ras Tanura and Rotterdam. Balances boil-off losses, fuel price volatility, and auxiliary berth emissions at discharge terminals.
